# jurisdiction place

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:jurisdictionPlace`](gmeow-jurisdictionPlace.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/jurisdictionPlace>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)

The place whose governance is recorded by this [`JurisdictionTenure`](../classes/gmeow-JurisdictionTenure.md). Functional: a tenure concerns exactly one place (constitutive of the situation's identity).

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to name the single place a jurisdiction tenure governs; functional, constitutive of the situation's identity.

### Avoid when

- Avoid governing several places in one tenure (mint one per place).

### How to use

- Set exactly one [`gmeow:jurisdictionPlace`](gmeow-jurisdictionPlace.md) per [`JurisdictionTenure`](../classes/gmeow-JurisdictionTenure.md).
